name: thrombomodulin

function.text: THBD is the approved symbol for thrombomodulin. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in calcium ion binding; signaling receptor activity; blood coagulation.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with thrombomodulin anomaly (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma; Endometrial carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.

function.text: THBD encodes thrombomodulin. Its functions include calcium ion binding and signaling receptor activity.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with thrombomodulin anomaly (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving THBD have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.
